description: Leathery brown membrane on finger-bones, with a claw at the crown. Whatever flies on these keeps to its cave.
lore: Look at the hook, not the wing. The inner curve is polished — not scuffed, polished, the way a stair rail goes under sixty years of the same hand — which means the animal hangs, and hangs in one place, often enough to wear horn smooth against rock. Somewhere there is a ceiling with a groove worn into it. A cracker worked all that out over a winter, was extremely pleased with himself, and carried the wing east to put it to [[characters/8c41be1e|Hearn]], who has been inside the only cave anyone means when they say the cave. Hearn turned it over twice, looked at the polish rather than the claw, said not that one, and handed it back. Twenty-two gold, and the wing is the cheap half of what you are buying. The rest is a room nobody has found.
gm_notes: Hearn will answer a question about the inside if it is about geology and not about the attempt. Establishes a second cave system, unexplored, as a hook.
